name: EVOPIXEL [1.21+]
description:
EVO PIXEL

Join EVO PIXEL, an exciting Minecraft server where you can enjoy a variety of fun features and game modes with your friends! We support free-to-play players, giving everyone the opportunity to enjoy a fun and rewarding experience without limits!

Game Modes

1. Survival Vanilla - Land Claims, Custom Enchants, Skills, Gacha, PvP, Fly, Ranks, Auction House, Player Warps, and much more.

2. Anarchy - No rules, no limits, and total freedom. Fight, survive, build, raid, and do whatever it takes to dominate the world!
